parameters.query: SELECT p.id, p.slug, p.name FROM architecture.projects p WHERE p.slug = $1;
SELECT id, stage, status, created_at FROM architecture.jobs WHERE project_id = $1 AND stage = 'project-management' AND status = 'completed' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;
INSERT INTO architecture.jobs (project_id, stage, input_job_id, status, meta) VALUES ($1, 'software-delivery', $2, 'running', '{}'::jsonb) RETURNING id, stage, status;
SELECT a.type, a.content, a.meta FROM architecture.artifacts a WHERE a.project_id = $1 AND a.type IN ('prd_md', 'brd') ORDER BY a.type, a.version DESC;
UPDATE architecture.jobs SET status = 'completed', completed_at = now() WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id, status;
